Thai has no spaces between words, so the bar finds the word you're typing, and next words come after a space. Double Space types two spaces, as Thai has no full stop.

name: हिन्दी
label: हि
howTo: Type Hindi by how it sounds, in English letters: namaste becomes नमस्ते. Capitals are sounds of their own (namaH, maChiyoM), so Shift changes the letter. Double Space types "। ", and a word ending in ~ keeps its last virama (agar~).

First, pick your characters on this page: Simplified, Hong Kong or Taiwan. Your code floats above the bar and the choices sit over the top row. Space types the first one, and a tap picks any. For more, press Shift, swipe up on the keys, or tap ⋯. Enter or a swipe turns the page. Next words follow each pick. Enter types the code as letters, and double Space types 。.

name: 日本語
label: あ
howTo: Type Japanese in romaji: kyou becomes きょう, nn ん, and - ー. Choices sit over the top row, whole sentences first. Space types the first one, and a tap picks any. For more, press Shift, swipe up on the keys, or tap ⋯. Enter or a swipe turns the page. When next words appear, tap one to use it. Enter types the romaji as letters, and double Space types 。.

guide.line: Japanese in romaji.
points: kyou gives きょう, nn ん, and - ー.
Whole sentences come first among the choices.
